description: Agent Control Plane Entry — first file every AI agent MUST read before any operation

handoff.description: Agent MUST read latest handoff before development and update after task completion

branch_strategy.development_line_rule: All feature/fix/refactor branches merge here. When stable, merge to main.
branch_strategy.temp_branches: trae/* (temporary workspace, auto-delete after merge, NEVER merge directly to main)
branch_strategy.stable_line_rule: Always compilable, runnable, releasable. All Release Tags created from main. NEVER commit directly to main.
branch_strategy.archive_policy: Each major version completion: merge v{N}-agent -> main -> tag -> create archive/v{N} -> delete v{N}-agent -> create v{N+1}-agent
branch_strategy.feature_branches: feature/*, fix/*, refactor/*, experiment/*, ui/*, service/*, core/*

rules.no_squash_merge: Use --no-ff merge to preserve complete commit history.
rules.no_force_push: NEVER force push to main or v6-agent.
rules.test_rule: Tests must pass before any merge to v6-agent or main.
rules.no_direct_main: NEVER commit directly to main. All changes go through v6-agent.
rules.trae_rule: trae/* branches are temporary. Merge to v6-agent only, then delete. NEVER merge to main.
rules.handoff_rule: Read handoff before work. Update handoff after work.

governance.description: Single Source of Truth for all Git policies, branch strategy, agent contracts, and identity rules
